node.statement: Challenge bridge. Validated node 1.4.1 establishes two independent failures of the original conjunction inference. First, for e>0 the estimate ||gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger||<=K_hom e||X|| does not imply the exact equality required by def-extended-delta-inclusion; changing C_merge affects only the size of approximate defects and cannot force that difference to vanish. The symmetrized map tilde_gamma is not the raw assembly because on a source (j,k)-corner it equals [gamma_jk(x)+gamma_kj(x^dagger)^dagger]/2, and the datum bounds but does not annul the difference from gamma_jk(x). Second, for every proposed a_merge>0, the root permits rho=0 and epsilon larger than e_0, so rho<=a_merge does not imply rho+epsilon<=e_0 and nodes 1.2 and 1.3 cannot be invoked. Thus no choice of constants repairs the claimed inference from the allowed hypotheses; the amendment correctly retracts the extended-isomorphism conclusion and records the necessary additional hypotheses or the weaker nearby-map alternative.
